name: vSphere Client / ESXi Host Client UI exposure (/ui/)

then.hypothesis: A vSphere management-plane web UI answers at /ui/ on this host (vCenter's vSphere Client and the ESXi Host Client share this path): one fingerprint pass against the host root - the templates request /ui/#/login and /sdk/ themselves, so the probe is anchored at the authority and never at the discovered path; a hit is an exposed management plane to triage, never an exploit
